title: RedKnot-MLA: Multi-Head Offline-Online Reuse for DeepSeek-V4 Long-Context Serving
abstract: arXiv:2609.07008v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multi-head latent attention (MLA) exposes many logical query heads through one packed latent KV stream. This representation is memory efficient, but it removes the physical per-head cache boundary assumed by conventional head-wise reuse. We present our system, a DeepSeek-V4 realization of RedKnot's head-aware reuse principle. Each immutable document is processed offline at canonical position zero; certified Local-head contributions are retained as MLA-Off. At serving time, query-side RoPE relocation restores the document's request position, a small Global-head set and protected Local token rows are recomputed as MLA-Online, and the two paths are merged before a single shared output projection. The packed MLA latent is never split. DeepSeek-V4-Flash uses 37 reusable layers and a 56/8 Local/Global partition, giving a 75.29% analytic logical head-row ceiling; the Pro-0813 profile uses 55 layers and 112/16 heads, giving 78.89%. Frozen Flash

translated_title: RedKnot-MLA：面向DeepSeek-V4长上下文服务的多头离线-在线复用
translated_abstract: 多头潜在注意力（MLA）通过一条打包的潜在KV流暴露多个逻辑查询头。这种表示方式内存效率高，但它消除了传统按头复用机制所依赖的物理按头缓存边界。我们提出了我们的系统，这是RedKnot头感知复用原则在DeepSeek-V4上的实现。每个不可变文档在离线阶段以规范位置零进行处理；经过认证的Local头贡献被保留为MLA-Off。在服务时，查询侧的RoPE重定位将文档恢复到其请求位置，一小部分Global头集合以及受保护的Local token行被重新计算为MLA-Online，两条路径在单个共享输出投影之前合并。打包的MLA潜在表示从不被拆分。DeepSeek-V4-Flash使用37个可复用层和56/8的Local/Global划分，可达到75.29%的解析逻辑头行上限；Pro-0813配置使用55层和112/16个头，可达到78.89%。Frozen Flash……
tldr: 该论文提出RedKnot-MLA系统，通过将不可变文档的Local头贡献离线缓存、服务时仅用RoPE重定位和少量Global头重计算并将两条路径在共享输出投影前合并，在不拆分打包MLA潜在流的情况下实现DeepSeek-V4长上下文推理的高效复用。
en_tdlr: This paper presents RedKnot-MLA, a head-aware offline-online reuse system for DeepSeek-V4 long-context serving that caches certified Local-head contributions offline, recomputes only a small Global-head set with RoPE relocation at serving time, and merges both paths before a shared output projection without splitting the packed MLA latent.
